title: Event envelope and kinds as frozen types
acceptance: every kind round-trips to JSON and back; unknown fields are rejected

title: Event writer: append, flush, optional fsync, torn-line cut, session lock
acceptance: a torn final line is cut before the next append; a second writer on one session file is refused; a crash while holding the lock does not block the next writer

title: Event reader and replay fold
acceptance: a torn final line is dropped and reported; any other broken line is an error; the same log always folds to the same state

title: Snapshots and Hypothesis stateful tests
acceptance: random appends, snapshots and replays agree with the fold; cutting the file at a random byte still replays to a consistent earlier state

title: Spend log: one line per model call
acceptance: a torn append never swallows the next line; month_to_date excludes the run's own lines; resume repairs a missing line

title: Rewind: run_forked and clean fork points
acceptance: a fork reads the parent up to and including from.seq; points with a pending tool call, open approval or open pause are refused

title: RunState, apply and the pure step function
acceptance: step does no I/O; state is a fold over the log

title: Driver: run, resume, ports and run_resumed
acceptance: a scripted fake model drives a run to finished; resume refuses a changed digest; a crash then late resume does not time out; resume calls repair_spend with the session lock held

title: Limits: check_limits, pauses and resume with limits
acceptance: each of max_turns, timeout, run_cap, month_cap and max_output_tokens pauses with its name; resume with limits continues; counts carry over

title: Retries with backoff and jitter
acceptance: the retry policy is pure; 4xx other than 429 is never retried; retry-after is honoured

title: Escalation ladder and the finish tool
acceptance: identical calls trip the detector at the threshold; nudge and switch never block; ask holds the turn; stuck completes pending calls; finish ends the run

title: Sandbox boundary: Permit or Refusal, env allow-list, timeout
acceptance: a parent secret never reaches the child; a timeout kills the process; every refusal is logged

title: Filesystem workspace: resolve_inside, generation counter
acceptance: ../, absolute paths, a symlink out and a symlinked parent are all refused; delete bumps the generation

title: Tool registry: schemas from type hints, execute
acceptance: schemas for nested types; invalid input gives a useful ok=false result

title: Tool scheduling, read_only, cache and timeouts
acceptance: conflicting calls run in emission order; a resumed run asks before re-running a tool that is not read_only; a timed-out call is abandoned and a late write still invalidates the cache

title: Context store: pack and compact
acceptance: packing respects the budget and always includes pinned items; compaction fires at the threshold; the stable prefix is identical across turns

title: System-prompt builder
acceptance: byte-identical output for the same inputs; a changed part changes only what follows it

title: Plan tool
acceptance: the plan file is always kept in context

title: Guard pipeline: pre and post guards, Redact, Ask
acceptance: a deny stops the tool and is logged; a post guard redacts a secret and the raw result never reaches the log; an ask pauses the run and resume continues from the log

title: Verifier hook: verify then reflect
acceptance: a failing verifier prevents finished and feeds back; a passing one ends the run

title: Observability: spans and token-based cost
acceptance: spans from a recorded log are stable; pricing from tokens matches hand-computed values; cache read and write tokens are priced separately

title: Scripted three-step eval in CI
acceptance: a fake model replays canned responses; the run reaches finished with a complete, replayable log

title: Bring your own loop: components work without the driver
acceptance: a hand-written loop calls the registry, sandbox, guards and context store directly, with no driver, and completes a task

title: Hello-agent example and write-up
acceptance: a second repository can import loomcore, register a tool and run a multi-step task to completion
